setup: Dumbbells at your shoulders, elbows forward
execution: Squat to at least thighs level
Drive up hard through your feet
Let the leg drive push the bells overhead
Lower to the shoulders and go again
faults: Don't press before your legs straighten
Don't let your elbows drop in the squat
Don't arch your back at lockout

notes: Pick a weight you can press overhead with control; the press is the weak link.
Lower the dumbbells back to the shoulders under control, not onto the collarbones.
When tired, stop or rest rather than letting the back arch overhead.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move
Chest pain, faintness or unusual breathlessness

keyPositions.label: Rack
keyPositions.describe: Standing tall, dumbbells resting on or just above the front of the shoulders, elbows forward.

keyPositions.label: Bottom

keyPositions.label: Drive

keyPositions.label: Lockout
keyPositions.describe: Standing tall with arms straight overhead, dumbbells over the shoulders, ribs down.
